name: Logibar
author: mryll
description: Combined battery status for Logitech Lightspeed devices (keyboard, mouse, headset) in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Click: battery panel per device. Middle click: refresh. Requires logibar-status on PATH.

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: Monochrome rendering uses foreground tones only — severity stays readable through the numbers and glyphs. none: no color anywhere. bar-only: colored bar face, plain panel. panel-only: the reverse.

schema.label: Show keyboard
schema.description: Battery of the connected Logitech keyboard (G915 TKL, G915 X TKL). The panel names the model.

schema.label: Show mouse
schema.description: Battery of the connected Logitech mouse (G Pro Wireless, PRO X Superlight, PRO X Superlight 2). The panel names the model.

schema.label: Show headset
schema.description: Battery of the PRO X 2 LIGHTSPEED headset.
